system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket

- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
## REVIEW OF SELLER DOCUMENTS AGAINST BUYER PLAYBOOK  
**Project Kestrel – Wattlebridge Holdings (Buyer) vs Harbourglass Ventures (Seller)**  

---

### MATERIAL DEPARTURES & REQUIRED PUSHBACK  

| # | Playbook Position | Seller Position | Departure & Reasoning | Required Pushback |
|---|-------------------|-----------------|----------------------|-------------------|
| **1** | **General Warranty Cap: 25% / AUD 6M** (20% / AUD 4.8M only with Amelia Frost written authority – **none given**) | 20% / AUD 4.8M (Cl 12.1) | Seller proposes the **fallback cap without authority**. This reduces Buyer protection by AUD 1.2M. | **Reject.** Restate 25% / AUD 6M cap. No fallback without principal sign-off. |
| **2** | **Thresholds:** De minimis AUD 5K; basket AUD 50K (first-dollar recovery once exceeded) | De minimis AUD 25K; basket AUD 250K (excess-only recovery) (Cl 12.2) | Seller’s thresholds are **5× higher**; basket is **deductible-style** (only excess recoverable) vs playbook’s first-dollar. Materially narrows claim scope. | **Reject.** Insist on AUD 5K / AUD 50K first-dollar basket. |
| **3** | **General Claims Period:** 24 months (18 months only with Amelia Frost written approval – **none given**) | 18 months (Cl 12.3/13) | Seller imposes fallback period **without approval**. Shortens claim window by 6 months. | **Reject.** Require 24 months. |
| **4** | **Fundamental/Title Regime:** Separate, 100% cap, ≥6 years, **outside** general basket/de minimis/knowledge bar | Title/capacity subject to **same caps, time limits, baskets** as general warranties “for administrative simplicity” | **Collapses fundamental protections into general regime** – eliminates 100% cap, long stop, and basket/knowledge carve-outs. Unacceptable. | **Reject entirely.** Draft separate fundamental regime: 100% cap, 6+ years, no basket/de minimis/knowledge qualifiers. |
| **5** | **Fraud/Wilful Concealment/Deliberate Misconduct:** Carved out of **all** caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies, non-reliance – **non-waivable** | “Limitations, exclusive-remedy and non-reliance provisions apply to **all Claims of any nature**” (Cl 9.3/12.8/20.5) | Seller attempts to **apply all limitations to fraud**. Directly contradicts playbook’s non-waivable carve-out. | **Red-line.** Insert express carve-out for fraud, wilful concealment, deliberate misconduct from every limitation, time bar, exclusive remedy, non-reliance clause. |
| **6** | **Disclosure:** Specific, fair disclosure only; **reject** whole-data-room, public-register, prudent-search deemed disclosure | General disclosure of **entire data room (DD-002–DD-012) + public registers + statutory registers** (Disclosure Letter [1.1]–[1.2]) | **Blanket data-room disclosure** shifts diligence burden to Buyer; not “fair disclosure” per playbook or NSW precedent. | **Reject general disclosure.** Require warranty-by-warranty specific disclosure; data-room index alone insufficient. |
| **7** | **Buyer Knowledge:** Delete blanket exclusions; any qualifier requires **named Seller knowledge persons + reasonable enquiry**; never excuses title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnity | “Buyer shall have no claim in respect of any matter of which the Buyer **or its advisers had knowledge, including any matter discoverable from the data room or public records**” (Cl 8.3) | **Blanket constructive-knowledge bar** covering advisers and data-room discoverability. Would nullify specific disclosure requirement and playbook’s knowledge-person framework. | **Delete Cl 8.3.** If knowledge qualifier retained: limit to **named Buyer individuals**, actual knowledge only, no constructive/deemed knowledge; **carve out title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnities**. |
| **8** | **Bluefen Consent:** Effective consent **+ evidence conditions satisfied** pre-Completion; reasonable endeavours insufficient | “Reasonable endeavours … treat consent as satisfied on delivery of counterparty’s written consent” (Cl 3/6.3); Disclosure [2] confirms **NO final consent, NO evidence conditions satisfied** | Seller offers only **reasonable endeavours + consent-on-delivery** for a ~30% revenue customer. Conditions in Cl 11.3 unproven. | **Require:** (a) executed Bluefen consent **before** Completion; (b) documentary evidence all Cl 11.3 conditions satisfied; (c) condition precedent, not reasonable endeavours. |
| **9** | **Riverlark:** Current payout **from Completion funds** + effective security releases; post-Completion release only with **irrevocable undertaking + Amelia Frost approval** | “Release to be provided **following Completion**” (Cl 2/7); Disclosure [3] confirms **facility NOT repaid, NO final discharge** | **Post-Completion release** with no undertaking, no Frost approval. Buyer bears risk of delayed/failed discharge on ~AUD 3.2M secured debt. | **Require:** (a) full payout + security releases **at Completion from Completion funds**; (b) if any post-Completion mechanics, irrevocable undertaking from Riverlark + Frost written approval. |
| **10** | **Employee Bonuses (DD-005):** AUD 420K **+ triggered on-costs** as specific line item or seller-funded; funds flow must not silently exclude | “Bonuses … **not separately itemised in the funds flow**”; Disclosure [5] silent on payroll tax, super, on-costs | **AUD 420K + unknown on-costs excluded from funds flow** – effectively a hidden price reduction or post-Completion liability. | **Require:** (a) specific line item in funds flow for AUD 420K + all statutory on-costs; **or** (b) Seller funds pre-Completion with evidence. No silent exclusion. |
| **11** | **Ironquay IP:** Broaden narrow indemnity, preserve SOW3 cure; AUD 180K **not independently verified** | “Existing indemnity limited to specific SOW3 payment … considered adequate” (Cl 11.1); Disclosure [4] confirms AUD 180K open, **no bank verification, no receipt/assignment in data room** | Seller refuses to broaden indemnity; **payment status unverified**; SOW3 transfer conditioned on “cleared payment of every SOW3 fee” (DD-004 Cl 7.3). | **Broaden indemnity** to cover IP ownership, third-party claims, breach of SOW3; preserve SOW3 cure; require **independent payment verification** or escrow/retention for AUD 180K. |
| **12** | **Export/Privacy Incident (DD-006):** Preserve logs, investigate, require updates; **assume NO confirmed breach/harm/notification duty/numeric demand** | “Preliminary operational matter … not expected to be material” (Cl 4.6/Sch 6); Disclosure [6] confirms **investigation preliminary, no confirmed breach, no loss amount** | Substance aligned (no confirmed breach), but Seller’s “not expected to be material” language risks **deemed disclosure** barring future claims if breach later confirmed. | **Insert:** (a) ongoing investigation covenant; (b) log preservation; (c) prompt updates; (d) **no deemed disclosure/knowledge bar** for this incident; (e) specific indemnity if notification/loss arises post-Completion. |
| **13** | **Sandbar Renewals (AUD 330K):** Assess; **no automatic Debt classification or price deduction** | “Ordinary-course operating costs” (Supplier renewals); Disclosure [8] **does not state** if unavoidable, terminable, accrued, or ordinary course | Seller pre-characterises as ordinary course; playbook requires **assessment**, not presumption. | **Reserve position.** Require disclosure of each renewal’s terms (termination rights, accrual status); treat as working-capital item unless Debt criteria met. |
| **14** | **Title Evidence:**
=== END ADVICE ===
